qualifiedRoutes.scope: Graph v1.0 Global, application-only, channel and user-chats scope kinds, hosted content in the base contract. All three options are off; option tuples own separate bundles.

SharePoint document-library root to a pre-existing Google Shared Drive folder, rclone onedrive client-credentials source and drive service-account destination, transfer v1.75.0. fullLiveMatrix is false: the package capability rests on live_source_entry, reference on source_refuses_creation, undownloadable on absent_from_source_scope, per ADR-0006.

Graph v1.0 Global to a disposable Google Shared Drive folder using a separate service-account credential. Three exposed root objects and two conversation ZIPs, downloaded and SHA-256 verified. Live container regeneration ignores changed filesystem timestamps; a lost upload acknowledgement recovers the reserved ID, and replay preserves object IDs, revision tokens and markers. The local-only archive tuple remains independently qualified.

Graph v1.0 Global to a local archive package, channel and user-chats scopes. Three conversations and 16 records include three retained versions: standard channel, private channel, and chat. Three hosted assets, exhausted retained paging, durable restart, and deterministic package regeneration. Private retained capability rests on a real collected version, not an omission. The sample covers edited text after tenant migration, not pre-migration coverage, deleted-message recovery, or retained hosted content; no migration completion timestamp was available. No Shared Drive destination or other option combination is qualified.

meaning: This is a release-prerequisite register, not a successful evidence bundle or route record.

gates.reason: CI run 35099461034 on 4ad8222c passed npm run check:package on all four cells: macos-15, macos-15-intel, ubuntu-24.04-arm and ubuntu-24.04. Each job asserts process.platform + '-' + process.arch equals its expected cell before installing, so the artifact was packed, installed and smoked on the exact native architecture rather than an emulated one. Typecheck, the behavioural suite and the real managed-worker check pass in the same job.
gates.scope: Run on every exact native desktop architecture; hosted CLI success does not prove native GUI behavior, which is the separate native_desktop_lifecycle_matrix gate.

gates.reason: darwin-arm64 only, recorded on PR #26 by operator inspection of the installed WKWebView. darwin-x64, linux-arm64 and linux-x64 remain unrun: the gate needs an interactive logged-in desktop session with macOS WebKit or Linux WebKitGTK 4.1 plus libxdo, which no hosted runner provides, so the workflow targets self-hosted runners carrying the cell label. Tracked as issue #32, ready-for-human.
gates.scope: Inspect the actual installed native window on all four cells. Native custom-protocol readiness alone does not prove ten-verb lifecycle parity or the absence of listeners; retain the separate per-cell launch/interaction evidence.

gates.reason: ADR-0005 and ADR-0006. The full file suite ran against a real SharePoint library and Shared Drive on darwin-arm64 with Node 24.21.0 and published the bundle recorded in qualifiedRoutes, carrying all seven file probes. fullLiveMatrix is false and every capability records its proof value with matching evidence: package live_source_entry from a real OneNote notebook the driver omitted, reference source_refuses_creation with the live HTTP 400, undownloadable absent_from_source_scope with a census of 12 scanned children and no item of that kind. Publication additionally required the bundle-validator realpath fix from the archive route's run, which had refused every bundle written under a symlinked ancestor.
gates.scope: Exact source/destination/backend/options/guarantee-set tuple, pinned transfer version, and each desktop cell. Only darwin-arm64 is captured; no credential or captured-output import can assert successful qualification.

gates.reason: ADR-0007. The full archive suite ran against a live Global tenant on darwin-arm64 with Node 24.21.0 and published the bundle recorded in qualifiedRoutes: route matrix, hosted-content bytes for both scope kinds including a channel reply, durable restart, and byte-deterministic package regeneration. Two live-only defects had to be fixed first: every export request used an inclusive lower bound the routes refuse with HTTP 400, and the bundle validator confined a realpath beneath an unresolved root, refusing any bundle published under a symlinked ancestor. The base capture has all options off; retained history now owns a separate gate.
gates.scope: Exact Graph route/permission/option tuple, pinned transfer version, and each desktop cell. The base tuple proves no options; retained history has separate local-only evidence, while transcripts and attachmentBytes remain unqualified.

gates.reason: Issue #33 and updated spec #17 story 33/section 11. On 2026-09-17 the complete live runner passed on Node 24.21.0 and darwin-arm64, capturing desktop runtime, Graph route matrix, hosted-content bytes, package self-consistency, and retained history. Three retained records include an actual private-channel version; all scoped retained paging is exhausted. A separate real archive smoke matched current v2 and original retained v1 for standard/private/chat messages against a pre-edit baseline, and both private versions were inspected in rendered HTML. The earlier categorical private-channel omission is removed. Existing fidelity findings remain recorded. Tenant migration was Completed, but its completion timestamp was unavailable.
gates.scope: Only the local Graph v1.0 Global channel+user-chats tuple with retainedHistory=true, transcripts=false, attachmentBytes=false, default guarantees, transfer v1.75.0, darwin-arm64. Edited-text samples do not prove pre-migration coverage, deleted-message recovery, retained hosted-content availability, or full native ten-verb lifecycle parity.

gates.reason: ADR-0008 and issue #41. Live darwin-arm64 capture on Node 24.21.0 includes the archive probes plus archive_destination: five real Drive objects, private provenance, full download byte verification, lost-acknowledgement restart, unchanged rerun, and destination verification without Graph credentials. Both live conversation containers reproduce their uploaded bytes after filesystem timestamps change. Evidence audited against live identifiers, names, email addresses and protected credential references; only counts, codes, public root filenames and digests are published.
gates.scope: Exact archive-with-destination tuple, all three archive options off, transfer v1.75.0, darwin-arm64 only. Neither the local archive bundle nor the file-route bundle substitutes for this evidence.

gates.reason: ADR-0005. SharePoint refuses every name the driver's guard refuses, measured live with HTTP 400 for "", ".", "..", a name containing "/", and a name containing NUL, so no source item can carry one. The finding is proven live through its other cause, a provenance marker beyond Drive's private-property capacity with a valid source name, and the source's own 400 is recorded. A source that does permit such names must still produce the live-source-entry proof.

ADR-0006. A OneNote notebook is a real package:oneNote item. Supplied as fixtures.specialSources.packageId and measured live on 2026-09-15/16, the driver omitted it with source_package_omitted, so the bundle records the live_source_entry proof with that omission assertion.

ADR-0006. Graph refuses to create a remoteItem in a document library, measured live on 2026-09-15/16 with HTTP 400 invalidRequest for a remoteItem facet naming an item in the same drive and HTTP 400 "The provided sharepointIds is invalid" for the sharepointIds form. The bundle records the source_refuses_creation proof with that live 400. A source that does hold a reference still owes live_source_entry.

ADR-0006. No API creates a malware-flagged or content-less item on demand, and the kind census of the mapping source root's children found none in the scanned scope, measured live on 2026-09-15/16. The bundle records the absent_from_source_scope proof with that census. A source that does hold one still owes live_source_entry.

nativePrerequisites.darwin: macOS 13.5 or newer with system WebKit and Node 24, on x64 or arm64. The user explicitly raised the floor to match the retained Node baseline.
nativePrerequisites.linux: A real X11 or Wayland desktop, WebKitGTK 4.1 and libxdo. Missing these blocks web only; there is no listener or external-browser fallback. Official Node GNU/Linux binaries require kernel 4.18+ and glibc 2.28+.
